messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired: inference-gateway error_rate 5xx > 4.5% (5m) in us-west2. PD escalation level: auto. Link: https://pagerduty.com/Incidents/PD12345

olga: Ack'd. I'm on it — taking primary triage. Any obvious customer impact?

matt: Seeing a spike on proxied model endpoints, 502/503s from kv-proxy layer. Errors started ~3:02pm PST, coincides with a small config push to edge router.

sachin: Confirming k-v cache evictions on several inference pods, logs show repeated OOM-ish failure in kv-shard worker:
```
2026-03-18T15:02:11Z ERROR kv-shard worker failed: OOM while allocating 128MB
2026-03-18T15:02:12Z WARN retrying request to model-backend
```
Rolling GC spikes too.

olga: Good signal. Matt can you roll the ingress back or flip the canary? If that's trivial do it now.

matt: Rolling canary back (edge-router v2 -> v1) now. `deploy-bot` will post status.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: edge-router service rollback to v1. Started 15:07 PST. CI/CD run id: cb-98234.

amy: Support: we have 2 active customers reporting API errors (acme-inc, shoply). Flagged for SRE follow-up and CS contact.

sachin: While rollback runs, recommending scaling inference-gateway pool by +30% to absorb retry storms and warm kv-cache. Command I'm running: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gateway --replicas=13 -n prod`

olga: Do it — prioritize warm starts over cost right now. Also enable short-circuit fallback to smaller model for non-LL features (embeddings/utility routes). Jess, fyi for potential product impact.

jess: Seen. I'll prepare messaging for customer success if errors persist > 15m. Let me know if any major tenants impacted.

matt: Rollback completed, edge-router back to v1. Proxy 5xxs dropping but still > baseline. Scaling done.

sachin: After scale, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% in 2 minutes. KV miss rate still elevated, doing a targeted cache-warm for top prefixes.

amy: Notified acme-inc and shoply: "We're aware of transient 5xxs and have rolled back a recent routing change. Mitigations are in progress." They appreciate the update.

olga: PD status: holding at auto -> oncall. If we see re-escalation, we'll promote to SE-level. Anyone see any lingering error patterns (auth, model timeouts, network)?

matt: Traces point to small subset of backend pods with high GC/heap churn. Suspect a memory regression in kv-client introduced last week. I'll pin pods and pull heapdump.

sachin: Opening a hotfix PR to limit per-shard memory usage + backpressure on client side. If hotfix quick, we can canary to 2 pods. Otherwise keep rollback.

olga: Action items -> 1) Matt: heapdumps + pinned pods (in progress). 2) Sachin: hotfix PR + canary if clean. 3) Amy/Jess: CS messaging and ticket updates. 4) I'll stay on for handoff in 30m.

amy: Creating internal incident ticket: INC-20260318-87. Linking PD incident. Adding affected customers list.

sachin: PR opened: https://git.redwood/inference/kv-client/pull/2187 - description: reduce per-shard cache cap, avoid full evictions. Running unit + smoke.

matt: Heapdump attached to ticket. Initial look matches memory blowouts after large prefix churn.

olga: Current customer-facing status: partial degradation for some requests in us-west2, majority restored. Keeping PD alert open. Oncall handoff if still active at 15:40 PST.

jess: If this stays degraded >30m I'll prepare an external status update draft.

pagerbot: PD incident updated: auto -> acknowledged by olga. Escalation paused.

amy: Noted. Keeping support channel hot.

olga: Thanks team — great fast responses. I'll continue monitoring and coordinate the handoff to night oncall if needed. :thumbsup:
